_readme: Every design token for the whole site lives here. Edit a value, run `node build.js`, refresh. Nothing else to touch. Current system: 'terracotta' (2026-08-05) — warm cream, fired-clay rust, sage stems. These are not approximations of Madhu's Orange & Mellow reference, they are SAMPLED OUT OF IT: 'bg-base' is the exact paper of `color pallete I like.png` (#F5EAD3), 'accent' is sampled from the rust blooms and 'sage' from the teal stems — since 2026-08-17 accent, ink-blue and the teal family are taken from the top-decile-CHROMA pixels of their regions, not the mean: averaging a watercolour region always greys it out, which is why the earlier means (#AE552C, #3C6B76, #68898C) read dull. The vivid samples are also MORE accessible, not less (accent went 4.25:1 → 4.74:1 on cream; the greyness was the contrast problem). bg-base matching the paper exactly is load-bearing, not just tasteful — the hero blooms are cut out of that photograph, so the cream showing through the gaps inside a petal is the page itself. Shift bg-base and those gaps stop matching. 'ink-blue' is the wordmark blue from that same reference — it sets the handwritten hero line and the display headings; change that one hex to retune every blue word on the site. 'brand-blue' is the ink the client logo wall is masked to (hover deepens to ink-blue); it is deliberately quiet — the logos are credentials, not headlines. It was #6FA8BC, a baby BLUE, and that was the one colour on the site outside the teal family: beside the #3C6B76 wordmark blue and the #68898C baby teal of the control sheet it read as a different palette. 2026-08-12 it became the baby teal itself, so the wall now sits in the same family as everything else and, as a side effect, clears 3:1 on the cream instead of 2.6:1. The previous emerald system is saved whole: `node tools/design-system.js restore rainforest`.

night._readme: Night-mode token overrides, emitted by build.js as [data-theme="night"]{...}. Same keys as 'colors' (subset) plus a 'glass' sub-block. The palette is the terracotta system moved onto its own deep-green surface: backgrounds come from the bg-deep family, the rust/teal families are resampled LIGHTER so every text pairing keeps WCAG AA on the dark grounds (verified in-session 2026-08-19: all body text >=4.5:1, display/UI >=3:1). text-on-accent flips DARK because night's accent fills are lighter than day's; day keeps cream labels.
